title: Web Event SMKN 1 Wonosobo
summary: Multi-role event management platform managing competition submissions, 3-stage milestone evaluation, automated deadline checks, jury scoring, and Google Gemini API AI assistance.
description: Web Event SMKN 1 Wonosobo (Sistem Manajemen & Evaluasi Event SMKN 1 Wonosobo) is a production-grade multi-role web platform built with Native PHP 8.2+ and MySQL (web_event_smk). Designed for school event operations, it features RBAC workflows for Admins, Teachers/Juries, and Students, 3-stage milestone tracking (awal, proses, akhir with automated is_late flags), FPDF progress report exports, Google Maps location integration, and an embedded Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI chatbot (api/chatbot.php).
problem: School events suffered from manual paper-based registration, untracked submission deadlines, fragmented multi-juror scoring calculations, and lack of real-time participant progress tracking.
solution: Engineered a centralized web platform supporting individual & team registration, automated 3-stage milestone tracking (awal, proses, akhir) with is_late flags, multi-criteria jury scorecards with real-time leaderboards, automated FPDF report generation, and an embedded Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI chatbot for instant event assistance.
implementation: Designed multi-role RBAC architecture regulating permissions across Admin, Teacher/Jury, and Student dashboards.
Built 3-stage milestone submission engine (awal, proses, akhir) with automated is_late deadline detection.
Engineered multi-criteria jury scoring matrices with automated weighted leaderboard calculation.
Integrated Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API chatbot (api/chatbot.php) providing context-aware answers to student queries.
Integrated FPDF engine for on-the-fly PDF scorecards, progress summaries, and certificate generation.
challenges: Managing complex relational data constraints across multi-participant team submissions and 3-stage milestone checks.
Safeguarding AI API integration endpoints against prompt injection while preserving fast chatbot response times.
results: Automated 100% of event registrations, milestone submission deadline tracking, and jury scorecard calculations.
Delivered instantaneous PDF report generation for school administrators and event coordinators.
lessons: Combining multi-role RBAC with automated milestone checks ensures accountability in complex event workflows.
Integrating AI chatbots directly into operational software greatly reduces repetitive administrative inquiry load.
